name: Starling Lab Capture-Store-Verify data integrity
use_case_subcategory_A: Digital-record provenance, authentication and decentralized archiving
reach_A: 10000 web pages archived in support of DFRLab
problem_addressed_A: Digital records face authenticity threats from misinformation and manipulation as well as loss through decay or attacks.
problem_addressed_B: Rising misinformation, deepfakes, generative AI, and digital manipulation threaten the authenticity, provenance, and integrity of digital records.

name: EASIER Data geospatial data preservation
use_case_subcategory_A: Geospatial data storage, provenance and verifiable location records
problem_addressed_A: Researchers and public-interest organisations need accessible, durable and verifiable geospatial data without dependence on centralized cloud services.
problem_addressed_B: Researchers, NGOs, and public institutions storing critical geospatial data like satellite imagery face risks of takedowns, censorship, and vendor lock-in on centralized cloud services, while digital media evidence lacks verifiable geographic provenance.

name: TRANSFER Data Trust artist-owned archive
reach_A: 5 named founding artists (counted from the reported list)
problem_addressed_A: Experimental media artworks risk loss through obsolescence or neglect, while artists lack control over their data and its value.
problem_addressed_B: Experimental time-based media artworks risk permanent loss to software obsolescence and institutional neglect while traditional art markets deny artists agency and equity over their digital work.

name: Akashic refugee digital memory archive
problem_addressed_A: Refugees' stories and cultural memories are lost, excluded or forgotten by conventional archives.
problem_addressed_B: Stories, memories, and cultural knowledge of refugees and displaced communities are lost, untold, forgotten, or overlooked by traditional archival systems.

name: Oceanic Whispers marine data trust (CROSSLUCID/RadicalxChange/Serpentine)
use_case_subcategory_A: Environmental data storage and data trust for an artistic installation
problem_addressed_A: Ecological data can remain inaccessible as an emotional experience rather than connecting people to ocean ecosystems.
problem_addressed_B: Raw ecological data from Marine Protected Areas sits underutilized in spreadsheets without public emotional connection or value returning to contributing scientists and marine environments.

name: Relay Funder aid platform for displaced communities
use_case_subcategory_A: Community crowdfunding, matching funds and locally governed treasuries
problem_addressed_A: Traditional aid loses resources to intermediaries, management overhead, payment fees and corruption rather than community priorities.
problem_addressed_B: Traditional humanitarian aid models suffer high overhead, slow delivery, and loss of funds to intermediaries, while displaced communities lack direct access to funding and governance.

name: Stablecoin for Impact (Launchnodes) yield to Giga school connectivity
problem_addressed_A: Institutional stablecoin capital earns little yield while social initiatives need funding that does not consume donor principal.
problem_addressed_B: Institutional stablecoin holders leave capital idle earning minimal yield, while conventional philanthropy requires spending down principal rather than donating sustainable yield.

name: Lido Impact Staking yield to MCV, UNICEF and Giga
problem_addressed_A: Social-impact projects need ongoing funding rather than disappearing pledged resources.
problem_addressed_B: Traditional philanthropy consumes donors' capital principal, whereas impact staking enables stakers to retain principal while channeling sustainable on-chain staking yield to global social impact initiatives.

name: Celo stablecoin payments for digital microwork (youth)
use_case_subcategory_A: Cross-border wage micropayments for digital work
population_groups_A: Low-income individuals; Other; Unbanked or underbanked; Women; Youth
population_groups_B: Low-income individuals; Unbanked or underbanked; Women; Youth
problem_addressed_A: High costs and delays in cross-border micropayments erode Kenyan youth's digital-microwork earnings and discourage participation.
problem_addressed_B: High transaction fees, slow processing, and friction in cross-border micropayments make digital microwork uneconomical for unbanked youth.

name: Smart-contract weather index insurance (inX/Etherisc/ACRE Africa)
population_groups_B: Low-income individuals; Rural communities; Smallholder farmers; Unbanked or underbanked; Women
problem_addressed_A: Slow, opaque and costly insurance processes undermine smallholder farmers' trust, uptake and ability to respond to weather shocks.
problem_addressed_B: Agricultural microinsurance suffers from complex claims settlement, opaque query processes, and lack of trust, causing low uptake and customer retention among smallholders.

name: DeFi merchant digitisation
population_groups_A: Low-income individuals; Micro-entrepreneurs or MSMEs; Unbanked or underbanked; Women
population_groups_B: Low-income individuals; Micro-entrepreneurs or MSMEs; Unbanked or underbanked
reach_A: 100 merchants (more than; service rollout over three months, not all active)
problem_addressed_A: Cash-based informal merchants struggle to manage working capital and access affordable financial services, while their distributor faces costly manual ordering and cash collection.
problem_addressed_B: Informal merchants operate on narrow margins without digital cash tracking or formal credit access, while local bank savings accounts offer rates too low to encourage saving.

name: DeFi salary advances / credit for smallholders
use_case_subcategory_A: Employer-based salary advances and smallholder credit
population_groups_A: Children; Low-income individuals; Other; Smallholder farmers; Unbanked or underbanked; Women
reach_A: 69 local landowners, casual labourers and full-time employees offered advances
problem_addressed_A: Smallholder farmers and casual workers lack affordable credit, while manual employer salary advances are difficult to scale.
problem_addressed_B: Smallholder farmers and agricultural workers in Kenya lack affordable credit options because traditional lenders deem small loans to irregular-income groups unprofitable and risky, while manual employer payroll advances face scaling bottlenecks.

name: Stablecoin buy-now-pay-later for MSMEs/informal vendors
population_groups_A: Low-income individuals; Micro-entrepreneurs or MSMEs; Women
reach_A: 141 food vendors surveyed in the six-month first phase (including 6% non-users)
problem_addressed_A: Food vendors lack affordable short-term working capital to replenish stock.
problem_addressed_B: Informal food vendors and MSMEs in Nairobi face high supplier costs and lack access to affordable working capital, relying on prohibitively expensive short-term loans.

name: Forest Carbon Web3 carbon projects
problem_addressed_A: Expensive, slow and opaque carbon-credit verification and intermediary commissions impede community access to carbon finance.
problem_addressed_B: High setup costs, manual audits, and intermediary broker margins in centralized carbon markets exclude local communities and reduce community revenue.

name: Blockchain anticipatory cash transfers for pastoralists (pilot + scale-up 2025-26)
population_groups_A: Low-income individuals; Other; Unbanked or underbanked
population_groups_B: Rural communities; Smallholder farmers; Unbanked or underbanked
reach_A: 262 pastoralists in the initial proof of concept
problem_addressed_A: Drought threatens pastoralist livelihoods while humanitarian support typically arrives after severe losses have already occurred.
problem_addressed_B: Prolonged droughts threaten pastoralist livelihoods, but traditional humanitarian aid arrives reactively after the worst drought impacts have occurred.

name: Haraka & Grameen Foundation onchain microfinance for VSLAs
population_groups_B: Micro-entrepreneurs or MSMEs; Rural communities; Smallholder farmers; Women
problem_addressed_A: Women with strong peer-lending histories face barriers to credit access.
problem_addressed_B: Lack of access to collateral-free credit for women in peer lending groups, and slow, expensive traditional microfinance processes.

name: Anticipatory cash transfers for flood-prone areas
population_groups_A: Low-income individuals; Other; Rural communities; Unbanked or underbanked
population_groups_B: Low-income individuals; Rural communities; Smallholder farmers; Unbanked or underbanked
problem_addressed_A: Reactive humanitarian aid and delayed warnings arrive too late to prevent flood losses in vulnerable Nepalese communities.
problem_addressed_B: Reactive post-disaster aid arrives too late to prevent losses, and communities lack localized, timely early warnings and automated cash assistance before floods strike.

name: Anzi grain tokenisation and credit guarantees
population_groups_A: Other; Smallholder farmers; Unbanked or underbanked
problem_addressed_A: Smallholder farmers cannot access affordable credit because lenders find grain collateral costly and complex to verify, manage and liquidate.
problem_addressed_B: Over 170,000 smallholder farmers in Argentina remain locked out of traditional credit systems due to high administrative costs, paperwork burdens, and lenders' reluctance to accept and manage stored grain in silo bags as collateral.

name: Aleo/Humanity Link privacy-preserving USDCx aid (with DRC)
population_groups_A: Other; Refugees or displaced people; Rural communities
population_groups_B: Refugees or displaced people; Rural communities
reach_A: 300 refugees reported as using the system; approximate pilot cohort
problem_addressed_A: Humanitarian cash delivery lacks an end-to-end approach combining efficient transfers, privacy protection and low-tech accessibility.
problem_addressed_B: Displaced individuals and migrants in Colombian border areas face severe extortion and security risks from armed groups when registering for aid because centralized databases and public ledgers expose sensitive personal identity and transaction data.

name: OS City (blockchain government records/credentials)
use_case_subcategory_A: Digital certification, credentials and provenance records
country_A: ARG; BRA; CHL; COL; ESP; MEX
reach_A: 4 Latin American countries with institutional implementations
problem_addressed_A: Access to trustworthy digital certification tools is limited, hindering transparent public records and validation of artisan products.
problem_addressed_B: Access to digital tools for creating and issuing tamper-proof, authentic, and verifiable credentials and origin certificates is typically unavailable to governments, schools, and artisans.

name: W3 Engineers TeleMesh blockchain-backed offline mesh messaging
population_groups_A: Children; Other; Refugees or displaced people
population_groups_B: Children; Refugees or displaced people; Rural communities
reach_A: 3 pilot locations in Bangladesh; user total not reported
problem_addressed_A: Displaced and marginalized people face barriers to mobile connectivity and communication.
problem_addressed_B: Lack of mobile and internet connectivity for unconnected and displaced populations living in areas without cellular networks or SIM cards.

name: BX Smart Labs smart-contract savings circles
problem_addressed_A: Savings-circle organisers face burdensome manual administration and collection of contributions.
problem_addressed_B: Managing informal savings circles (tandas) is burdensome, reliant on manual tracking, location-constrained, and vulnerable to trust breakdowns among low-income populations.

name: Kotani Pay transfers, savings and payments
population_groups_A: Low-income individuals; Other; Refugees or displaced people; Rural communities; Unbanked or underbanked; Women; Youth
population_groups_B: Low-income individuals; Refugees or displaced people; Rural communities; Unbanked or underbanked; Youth
problem_addressed_A: People without smartphones, internet connectivity or bank-account eligibility are excluded from digital financial services.
problem_addressed_B: Lack of internet connectivity, smartphones, or bank accounts preventing communities from accessing blockchain technology and financial services.

name: Rumsan Rahat cash and voucher assistance
use_case_subcategory_A: Humanitarian cash and voucher assistance; anticipatory cash
population_groups_B: Low-income individuals; Rural communities; Unbanked or underbanked
problem_addressed_A: Slow, expensive and opaque humanitarian transfers involve intermediaries and create leakage and last-mile delivery challenges.
problem_addressed_B: Traditional humanitarian cash relief mechanisms are slow, costly, and lack transparency, with multiple intermediaries increasing risks of leakage and inefficiencies.

name: Xcapit blockchain wealth management and financial learning
use_case_subcategory_A: Savings, investment and financial planning wallet
population_groups_A: Rural communities; Unbanked or underbanked; Youth
population_groups_B: Rural communities; Unbanked or underbanked; Youth
population_groups_final: Rural communities; Unbanked or underbanked; Youth
reach_A: 14000 users onboarded in the first two months (over 14,000)
problem_addressed_A: People without banking access or financial expertise lack accessible savings and investment tools.
problem_addressed_B: Lack of access to financial education, planning tools, and investment mechanisms for unbanked and non-financially savvy populations in Latin America.

name: GovBlocks decentralised decision-making tools
problem_addressed_A: Centralised boardroom decision-making excludes communities from governance.
problem_addressed_B: Boardroom-led decision making and lack of community inclusiveness in governance for decentralized business models.

name: Grassroots Economics community currency / emergency payments
use_case_subcategory_A: Community inclusion currency and resource-backed credit
population_groups_A: Low-income individuals; Other; Rural communities; Women
population_groups_B: Low-income individuals; Rural communities; Unbanked or underbanked; Women
problem_addressed_A: Low-income communities lack cash and formal credit during crises despite having goods and services available to exchange.
problem_addressed_B: In times of economic shock, low-income communities face acute liquidity and credit shortages despite possessing actual goods, services, and productive capacity.

name: Convexity CHATS cash and voucher platform
population_groups_A: Children; Low-income individuals; Other; Refugees or displaced people; Women
population_groups_B: Children; Low-income individuals; Refugees or displaced people; Unbanked or underbanked; Women
reach_A: 13613 unique beneficiaries across three humanitarian projects
problem_addressed_A: Fraud and misappropriation impede accountable delivery of humanitarian aid to intended beneficiaries.
problem_addressed_B: Humanitarian aid in Africa suffers from substantial fraud, diversion, and lack of transparency, preventing funds from reaching intended vulnerable beneficiaries.

name: WiiQare health-savings vouchers
reach_A: 39 users with successful Health Pass transactions in the DRC
problem_addressed_A: Lack of money delays access to healthcare in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
problem_addressed_B: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, access to quality healthcare is expensive, tedious, and delayed by lack of money, leading to preventable death and injury.

name: Investtools blockchain resource-delivery marketplace
problem_addressed_A: Internet providers lack commercial incentives to connect remote schools because new infrastructure cannot be financed by paying customers.
problem_addressed_B: Connecting remote and hard-to-reach schools to the internet is unprofitable for commercial internet service providers due to high infrastructure costs that cannot be recouped from paying consumers.
